notes.subject: moya
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/breath/life-force, not an immaterial 'soul'; Sepedi moya (breath/life) keeps the concrete sense.

notes.subject: phoofolo ya ba humanegago
notes.rationale: Second חית echoes the beast of line one — 'the beast-prey of your poor ones' (i.e. your poor given as prey to beasts) vs KJV 'congregation of thy poor'; Sepedi keeps the literal repetition.

notes.subject: thapelo
notes.rationale: Petition directed to Yahwe with two imperatives of deprecation.

translation: O se ke wa nea moya wa leei la gago phoofolong ya naga; phoofolo ya ba humanegago ba gago, o se ke wa e labalala go ya lelele.
